title: That explains the milk in the cocoanut and absence of hair on the animal’s chest
html_source: Joyce is making a play on an expression that describes a conundrum – “I have accounted for how the milk got into the coconut, but not the hair outside” – and subverting it to mock (in the mind of Joe) Bloom’s masculinity – “the absence of hair on the animal’s chest.”
